capabilities: Summarize notes locally or via a local model
Suggest and merge frontmatter tags, single note or whole folder
Wrap unlinked mentions in wikilinks in place
Write weekly, backlog and resurface digests to Weekly Digest.md
Build a local embedding index for semantic related notes and lookup
extras: All local commands work with no network or model; backend and embedding commands need a local server. Embedding index is stored in the plugin's data.json on-device; a ~5,000-note first build takes tens of minutes. Ships a free 30-note demo vault (HiveMind-OS) attached to the 1.5.0 release. MIT licensed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to summarize notes, propose tags or surface unlinked mentions and forgotten notes without sending note text to a remote service.

requires.name: Ollama or another OpenAI-compatible local server

summary: Local-first plugin that summarizes notes, suggests tags and unlinked mentions, and builds weekly, backlog and resurface digests, optionally using a local Ollama model.
